data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The 1-of-9 compile.py result is not evidence that the test constrains its subject; it is evidence that the mutation was planted in a path the author had already decided not to guard. The 3-of-26 distribution is an artefact of mutation selection: the mutations were proposed by models that had read the acceptance record, so they were biased toward already-guarded code or already-unguarded code. A test constrains its subject only when the mutation is adversarial to the test's stated intent, and that condition is not established for the 1-of-9 loss.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the mutation generator's access to the acceptance record is shown not to bias placement, the confound disappears.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1-of-9 lost mutation is in code that the author explicitly claimed was guarded, then the result is not explained by selection bias.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a blind mutation run on the same code produces the same distribution, then generator bias is not the operative condition.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 3-of-26 result is stable across independent mutation authors, the artefact claim fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Mutation selection bias creates a confound between test strength and mutation placement. If the mutations were generated with knowledge of which paths were guarded, then the observed catch rates reflect the generator's priors, not the tests' constraining power. The 1-of-9 loss may indicate a mutation placed in a known-unguarded region, which tells us nothing about whether the test would constrain a randomly placed mutation. The 4/4 to 6/7 results may similarly reflect that those modules' mutations were placed in already-tested territory.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
